description: Lot-et-Garonne : Positionnement des points kilométriques du canal latéral à la Garonne is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sdis47.fr. Point determined from a starting point located along the side channel to the Garonne. Date of publication: 2009. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Lot-et-Garonne: Positioning of odometer points from the side channel to the Garonne" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include points kilométriques, risques, inspire. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
